needs_from_others: LEAD DECISION: 15 of the 28 lint findings are html-fake-control on tabindex="-1", which marks a focus target, not a Tab stop. The files are screens/checkout.html:21, checkout-errors.html:21, checkout-result.html:15, assistant-done.html:50, demo-error-summary.html:16, pattern-payment-failed.html:14, pattern-search-empty.html:27, agent-test/settings.html:15, agent-test/settings-saved.html:19, docs/components/error-summary.md:7 and :33, and docs/patterns.md:38, :82, :102 and :123.
